system.longDesc:
Rather than bullets, the firearm shoots small, sharp shards of metal or plastic, inflicting Impact rather than Ballistic damage. This makes Impact armor far more effective against a flechette weapon but Ballistic armor less effective. Flechette ammo is not interchangeable and requires a weapon specifically designed to fire it; flechette guns cannot fire regular bullets nor can regular guns fire flechette ammo.

Resources TN 6.
